description: This file contains utility methods related to fuel injection control, including functions for testing injectors, fuel pumps, ignition, and other engine-related hardware components. It also provides mechanisms for bench testing and debugging specific engine functions.

classes.name: OutputPin
classes.description: Represents an output pin for controlling hardware signal outputs, with methods to set values and unregister outputs.

methods.name: isRunningBenchTest
methods.description: Returns whether the bench test is currently running.

methods.name: assertCylinderId
methods.description: Validates if the provided cylinder ID is within valid range; logs and asserts on invalid input.

methods.name: isInjectorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific injector (by cylinder ID) is enabled.

methods.name: printInjectorsStatus
methods.description: Logs the status of all injectors.

methods.name: setInjectorEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables an injector by ID and logs the new status.

methods.name: runBench
methods.description: Performs a bench test on a specified output pin with given timing parameters.

methods.name: pinbench
methods.description: Prepares parameters for a bench test, signaling the bench thread to execute.

methods.name: doRunFuel
methods.description: Initiates a fuel injector bench test for a specific cylinder.

methods.name: fuelbench2
methods.description: Configures and executes a fuel bench test with given timing and repeat count.

methods.name: fanBenchExt
methods.description: Sets up a fan relay test with specified duration.

methods.name: fanBench
methods.description: Runs a fan relay bench test for 3 seconds.

methods.name: milBench
methods.description: Runs an engine indicator light blinking test for 16 seconds.

methods.name: fuelPumpBenchExt
methods.description: Sets up a fuel pump relay test with specified duration.

methods.name: fuelPumpBench
methods.description: Runs a fuel pump relay bench test for 3 seconds.

methods.name: fuelbench
methods.description: Configures and runs a fuel injection bench test.

methods.name: doRunSpark
methods.description: Initiates a spark ignition bench test for a specific cylinder.

methods.name: sparkbench2
methods.description: Configures and runs a spark bench test with specified timing.

methods.name: sparkbench
methods.description: Runs a spark ignition bench test.

methods.name: dizzyBench
methods.description: Runs a testing sequence for the distributor (dizzy) output.

methods.name: benchThread
methods.description: Thread responsible for executing scheduled bench tests.

methods.name: runBenchTest
methods.description: API to trigger a bench test based on subsystem and index parameters.

methods.name: initInjectorCentral
methods.description: Initializes the injector control system, including setting up the bench thread and command actions.
